interface_detail: a REST API of single-action HTTP endpoints, plus Playwright and Puppeteer over a CDP WebSocket
tooling: Playwright and Puppeteer over CDP; a REST API
chaining: none at this price: a crawl that can use a USD 19 plan should

limits.value: 2 concurrent browsers on Free, 10 on Prototyping, 40 on Starter
2-minute maximum session time on Free; session reconnects bill a fresh unit
consumer-connection proxy is 6 units per MB and datacenter 2 units per MB, drawn from the same 1,000-unit pool

limits_note: the entry paid plan is USD 350 a month, and the free plan is not a trial: it renews monthly with no card
notes: The USD 350 tier is above Prototyping and Starter, not below them. The row is a small free allowance rather than a paid-only row.

free_tier.stated: Free plan at USD 0 a month, no card required: 1,000 units a month, 2 max concurrent browsers, 2-minute max session time, 1 day of persisted sessions and replays, consumer-connection proxies at 6 units per MB and datacenter at 2 units per MB, automatic human-verification handling, and Chrome, WebKit and Firefox on San Francisco, London and Amsterdam endpoints. One unit is a block of browser time of up to 30 seconds per browser connection
free_tier.notes: 1,000 units at up to 30 s each is 8.3 browser hours a month, and the 2-minute session cap forces a new connection per 2 minutes. Paid plans are Prototyping USD 25, Starter USD 140 and a USD 350 tier above those

egress.terms: no general data-transfer allowance or per-GB price published; only proxy traffic is metered, at 6 units per MB (residential) and 2 units per MB (datacenter) from the same unit pool, with units over the pool at USD 0.0020 on Prototyping

identity_cost.detail: the free plan needs an email signup and no card; a paid plan needs a payment method

evidence.proved: a Free plan at USD 0/month, 'No card required', 1k units/month, 2 max concurrent browsers, 2 min max session time; 'A Unit is a block of browser time of up to 30 seconds per browser connection'
proxy traffic is metered in units per MB; no other transfer allowance is listed

evidence.quote: Browserless REST APIs provide HTTP endpoints for common browser tasks like

evidence.proved: Playwright and Puppeteer connect by changing the endpoint
evidence.quote: Quick endpoint change enables connection with existing scripts.

session_cap.note: 2 min maximum session on Free; a reconnect bills a fresh unit

binding_note: the 2-minute session cap and the unit-per-reconnect rule bind before the 1,000-unit pool does, because a crawl that needs a longer session pays twice for the same page
